title: Mathematics Library
route_evidence_note: Existing program, D80, D100 and R48 routes were supplied as confirmed on 2026-09-19. The six EGA/FGA/Stacks translation repository URLs were checked by the coordinating owner on 2026-09-21. The collected-works repository and its README were checked on 2026-09-21. Dates for later routes are recorded on their edition or source fields.
description: A directory of mathematics study programs, research-course drafts, collected works and reference editions. Each work retains its own editorial status and edition routes.

collections.title: Study programs
collections.description: Course maps and published readers, from a broad route through mathematics to sustained study of a single subject.

collections.title: Advanced research courses
collections.description: Four English course drafts connect analysis, geometry and operator algebras. Their frozen R5B snapshot contains 155 draft reading units, including two separately authored operator-algebra bridges. This counts available draft lessons, not the proportion of the subject covered. Open proof obligations remain; these unofficial AI-written drafts are not admitted as complete results.

collections.title: Collected works
collections.description: A working library of modern editions and translation drafts, with editable sources, coverage maps and provenance records.

collections.title: EGA, FGA & SGA
collections.description: Source repositories for EGA and FGA, with each available language route identified separately. Repository access does not imply a complete edition or a published HTML reader; SGA routes await confirmation.

collections.title: Companion sources
collections.description: Separate draft collections and downloadable research materials. These do not stand in for the study programs or published reference editions.

items.title: Mathematics study program
items.summary: Two interface languages for a 40-course study map. Follow the course descriptions, prerequisites and reading routes; each linked work has its own content language.
items.note: A course map describes the program; it is not a claim that every course reader is complete.

items.title: Methods of Algebra, Volume 2
items.summary: The existing English HTML reader associated with D80. Continue directly into the reader from this library entry.
items.note: This entry points to the existing edition; the library does not reproduce its text.

items.title: Algebraic Geometry Bridge
items.summary: A three-book English course reader. Enter through the existing reader home to retain its sequence and navigation.
items.note: The reader remains part of the mathematics study program.

items.title: Elliptic Operators and Boundary Problems
items.summary: An advanced course draft on elliptic operators and boundary problems: 29 draft reading units in the R5B collection.
items.note: Reading link not yet published. Open proof obligations remain.

items.title: Microlocal Sheaves
items.summary: An advanced course draft on microlocal sheaf theory: 55 draft reading units in the R5B collection.
items.note: Reading link not yet published. Open proof obligations remain.

items.title: Modular Theory and Weights
items.summary: An advanced course draft on modular theory and weights: 40 draft reading units in the R5B collection.
items.note: Reading link not yet published. Open proof obligations remain.

items.title: Crossed Products and Flow of Weights
items.summary: An advanced course draft on crossed products and the flow of weights: 29 producer lessons and two separately authored bridge units in the R5B collection.
items.note: Reading link not yet published. Open proof obligations remain.

items.title: Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts
items.summary: A working library of modern, inspectable LaTeX editions and translation drafts of older mathematics and physics manuscripts. The collection provides reading editions, editable sources, coverage maps and provenance records.
items.provenance_label: Editions & translation drafts · status varies by work
items.note: Browse the collection’s own work and edition status records. Languages, completion, original sources and editorial responsibility are specified there for individual works.

items.title: Éléments de géométrie algébrique
items.summary: French source materials and a separately maintained English discovery edition. Choose the repository for the language you want to inspect.
items.provenance_label: Reference work · source and discovery-edition repositories
items.note: These links open source repositories, not verified complete HTML readers. Consult each repository for coverage, original-source provenance, editorial status and rights.

items.title: Fondements de la géométrie algébrique
items.summary: A public French source repository for FGA, with its own source records and edition status.
items.note: Repository access does not establish complete coverage or a published HTML reader. Consult its native source, editorial and rights records.

items.title: Séminaire de géométrie algébrique
items.summary: A reserved directory entry for the SGA volumes and their future registered reference editions and translations.
items.provenance_label: Original reference series · editions to be registered
items.note: Volume-specific routes, available languages and editorial attribution are awaiting confirmation. No translation is presented here as the original work.

items.title: Stacks translation editions
items.summary: Separately maintained AI translation drafts of the Stacks Project in Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Select a language to inspect its source repository.
items.provenance_label: AI translation drafts · review in progress
items.note: These are translations of the Stacks Project, not translations of every unofficial AI extension. Comprehensive expert review is not claimed; coverage, source provenance and rights remain documented by each repository.

items.title: Unofficial Stacks Project AI drafts
items.summary: A separate public draft release with a PDF and source materials. The release describes 36 chapters and 3,444 pages; these are release statistics, not course coverage.
items.note: This is not an official Stacks Project edition or the four-course research reader. The source ZIP includes dependencies; a direct .tex companion is not a standalone build target.
